content:
Total inflow: \(100 \text{ ml/min} \times 60 \times 9 = 54000\) ml.

Evaporation:
- Hours 1-4: \(4 \times 200 = 800\) ml
- Hours 5-9: \(250 + 300 + 350 + 400 + 450 = 1750\) ml

Total evaporation: \(800 + 1750 = 2550\) ml.

Water before dumping: \(54000 - 2550 = 51450\) ml.

After dumping 15 liters: \(51450 - 15000 = 36450\) ml.

\boxed{36450}
